changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0059. Trainer employment fields on the existing trainer profile. Index review: none until the following changeset. Performance note: columns are unused by list queries until indexed.

changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0060. Trainer assignment history, targets, and incentive rules. MemberProfiles.AssignedTrainerId stays the current trainer. Index review: PK on each id; UX_TrainerProfiles_TenantId_EmployeeCode for optional codes; UX_TrainerMemberAssignments_ActiveMember allows one open assignment per member; IX_TrainerMemberAssignments_TrainerId lists a trainer's members; UX_TrainerTargets_Period stops a duplicate target; UX_TrainerIncentiveRules_Tenant_Type keeps one rule per target type. Performance note: assignment and performance reads filter by TenantId first.

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE app.TrainerIncentiveRules; DROP TABLE app.TrainerTargets; DROP TABLE app.TrainerMemberAssignments; DROP INDEX UX_TrainerProfiles_TenantId_EmployeeCode ON app.TrainerProfiles;
